perplexity.description:
Released on 16 June 2017 by Spoon Records, The Singles is a comprehensive collection of Can’s single releases, spanning their influential career in experimental rock. The album compiles tracks originally issued as singles, including notable songs such as “Spoon,” “She Brings the Rain,” “Turtles Have Short Legs,” and “I Want More.” Musically, the collection showcases Can’s signature blend of motorik rhythms, tape manipulation, and improvisational rock, reflecting their pioneering role in the Krautrock movement. The album’s sequencing highlights the band’s evolution, from the hypnotic, psychedelic textures of their early work to the more focused, rhythm-driven sound of their later years.

The Singles occupies a unique place in Can’s discography, serving as both a retrospective and an accessible entry point for new listeners. Unlike their studio albums, which are often celebrated for their sprawling, experimental nature, this compilation emphasizes the band’s ability to distill their avant-garde sensibilities into concise, single-length formats. The collection received positive critical attention for its historical value and for capturing the breadth of Can’s sonic experimentation, with reviewers noting its importance for fans and newcomers alike. While not a commercial blockbuster, the album was praised for its curation and for reaffirming Can’s enduring influence on rock and experimental music.
